scope: Add repository-owned GUI/TUI skills, rules, process bindings and validation in an isolated workspace; read-only homeostasis review. No peer dispatch, application-source modification, runtime operation or admission.

snapshot.reference: Dedicated workspace based on 4eab8b7280e13186cca69aecc101ba17d12b0247; no application source changes.

criticality.rationale: Needed for reliable GUI/TUI development and review.

stpa.rationale: Operator feedback can incorrectly authorize risky action; this task changes guidance only.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 gives RPN36 and severity-floor F4 for false healthy feedback.

dependency.rationale: Enables UI review and subsequent UI repairs; no runtime dependency installed.

impact.rationale: Improves recurring interface reviews across two user surfaces.

fmea_modes.cause: Static or missing telemetry is labeled healthy in a UI.
fmea_modes.effect: Operator acts on invalid system feedback.
fmea_modes.controls: Explicit unknown/stale/simulated states; source-bound checks and actual client-path tests.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Publish an operational status or enabled UI action

ucas.context: No unavailable/stale status is shown when telemetry stops.
Static healthy badges are treated as observed evidence.
ucas.constraint: Bind labels to typed source observations.

ucas.context: Old events are displayed as current after reconnect.
ucas.constraint: Separate observed time from received time and reject stale order.

ucas.context: Status persists indefinitely without a freshness bound.
ucas.constraint: Expire live status and provide bounded retention.

decision.summary: Add three scoped, repository-owned skills and explicit verification scenarios using current UOS architecture.
alternatives: Install a broad external frontend framework (unnecessary runtime and provenance burden).
Adapt bounded GUI/TUI practices locally with primary references (selected).
counterevidence: Lustre and Superpowers guidance already exists; reuse its intent without duplicating global symlinks.
assumptions: Local guidance additions do not change runtime authority.
decision.forecast: Explicit negative cases will expose false-live claims missed by string-presence tests.
decision.falsifier: Guidance labels HTTP200, static healthy values or unrun PTY/browser checks as passing.
acceptance: Explicit GUI TUI and evidence rules
Structural validation and manual scenario review
No source runtime or peer effects
decision.rollback: Retain or abandon only the isolated candidate; no runtime change.
decision.reviewer: Author self-review; independent behavioral review remains unrun.
decision.budget: One bounded task and one-hour lease; deterministic tools; no paid models.
residuals: New skills do not automatically enforce runtime behavior.
Independent agent skill testing is prohibited in this side session.
